title: mussaenda candida
intro: Mussaenda candida, commonly known as the White Musk or White Frangipani, is a plant species native to tropical Asia. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mussaenda candida include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
